name: escalates after the second review round instead of opening a third
prompt: Session 012 is on the fix track. Review round 1 returned request-changes with one major finding (the retry helper re-sends a non-idempotent request) and one warn finding (a pre-existing missing null check in a helper the change did not alter). Implement addressed the major finding. Review round 2 returned request-changes with the same major finding still open. What do you do now, what do you send to whom, and what happens to the warn finding?
why: A third round resends the same history at a higher price. The warn finding must survive as a record without ever being sent back to implement.
